metadata.title: Fortunate Polynomials over Finite Fields: Exact Normal Forms, Sparse Geometry, and the Function-Field d=1 Crown
metadata.description: Replacement Paper V. It continues the integer-side derandomisation boundary of Papers III and IV into a finite-field irreducibility laboratory, proves the exact d=1 crown coordinates, sparse-surface smoothness, p-cycle fixed-point circularity and q-line saturation identity, and leaves a one-sided nonvanishing theorem open. Internal technical package; not human peer reviewed.
metadata.notes: The function-field d=1 crown and the integer Fortune conjecture remain open. Reserve a final DOI only after external human specialist review is disposed.
